public_rationale: The antecedent is unknown: the reviewed evidence does not establish that the illicit-revenue allegation was even half true. Under the conditional-forecast rule, the prediction cannot yet be scored. It also has no deadline. Culper's loss thesis and NVIDIA's outlook do not establish a decisive cessation of the alleged stream.
limitations: The antecedent depends on unresolved transaction and export-legality questions.
Company guidance uses a different scope from alleged indirect illicit sales.
An eventual forecast without a deadline cannot be falsified merely by observing continuing revenue for a limited period.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If Culper's allegation is even half true, NVIDIA's China-derived revenue is going away or already gone.
conditions: if the Culper allegation is even half true

statement.excerpt: If that’s even half true — and I believe it, given everything else you’ve read today — that revenue is either going away or is long gone depending on how stupid NVIDIA has been.

from_speaker: is either going away or is long gone
depending on how stupid NVIDIA has been
our_interpretation: The antecedent requires substantial confirmation of at least half the alleged illicit fiscal 2026 revenue described immediately before this sentence.
The predicted outcome is loss of the identified illicit China revenue stream, whether already completed or occurring later.
No deadline is supplied. The post date is November 10, 2026.
Replacement sales to other customers would not by themselves refute the disappearance of this particular stream.
The accounting basis is estimate because the stream is defined by the adopted research allegation.
criteria.support_condition: After the antecedent is established, reliable evidence shows that the identified illicit revenue stream has ceased, either before publication or subsequently.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent is established, decisive evidence would need to rule out the claimed cessation. Continued sales for a finite period cannot by themselves refute an eventual outcome with no deadline.
